description: Follow-up from Arc 60 (stoa--rdh). team-launcher landed in substrate/skills/ but is HELD OUT of SKILL_NAMES because it is the-stoa-specific: its central command ./launch-team.ps1 and its HUMAN_paste-*-init.md activation refs live at the the-stoa repo ROOT, not in the skill subtree that install.sh deploys. Deploying as-is hands a consumer an inert/broken skill. To generalize: (1) bundle launch-team.ps1 (or a consumer-generic equivalent) INTO the skill subtree so it deploys; (2) de-the-stoa the paste/seat references (parameterize HUMAN_paste-*-init.md, project-slug, seat names); (3) add a Windows wt fallback; (4) THEN add team-launcher to install.sh SKILL_NAMES. ARGUS R2 + DAEDALUS design §2.3 named this as the required follow-up. Anchor: stoa--rdh Arc 60.

comments.text: NOMOS activated on stoa--h8w (generalize team-launcher for consumer deploy). Reading the deliverable + repo ground truth across 6 probes: SKILL_NAMES wiring, skill subtree, consumer-generic launcher, parse check, consumer deploy, source committed+pushed.
Probes 1-3 absorbed; running parse check (pwsh ParseFile) + consumer-deploy + git ground-truth probes.

title: Generalize team-launcher skill for consumer deploy (bundle launch-team.ps1 + de-the-stoa paste refs, then wire into SKILL_NAMES)
